Skills-docs: none (no skills/ page names `deletePolicy`, `deletedField` or `_sync_deleted_at`: `git grep -c -E "deletePolicy|deletedField|_sync_deleted_at" -- skills/` exits 1 with zero hits at 167cb91793, control `git grep -c "name:" -- skills/` hits; the guide that teaches them is `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx`, updated here)

## 维护者速读
- 同步数据的管理员会看到:源系统删掉的记录,在平台里被打上"源已删除"标记(不会真删),源里恢复后标记自动清除;增量同步若没说明如何识别删除,保存时会被拒。
- 属于"单向同步进平台(sync-in)"这件事的第六步:让同步能如实反映源系统的删除。
- 出错时最坏是某些行被误标或漏标为"已删除",数据本身不丢、不删;下一次完整同步会纠正,改动可整体撤回。
- 无

## What changes

ADR-0153 D3 (delete marking) on both sync-in read paths, plus the carried review nits. Not in this PR (later slices of the card): D4 purge, D6 drift, D8 refusals beyond what landed, the connector paging loop.

- **Delete marking** (`packages/services/service-automation/src/sync-delete-mark.ts`, new sibling module). Under `deletePolicy` absent (reads as `'mark'`) or `'mark'`, a pull stamps `_sync_deleted_at` on a row the source deleted and clears it when a later pull reads the row again; `'ignore'` leaves every row. Two detections:
  - `deletedField`, on any pull that declares it: truthy marks the row's copy, anything else clears it.
  - Absence, on a full pull whose read was complete: every row of this mapping (`_sync_source`) not stamped by this run (`_sync_pulled_at` before the run start) and not refused by it is marked.
- **Completeness, per ADR-0153 D3.** Datasource source: `full: true`, the windows read to their end on either read path, and the NULL-watermark count (D2 invariant 11, under the D8 organization predicate; through the floor on a floored driver, recorded as cap plus one above the cap) is zero, else `unjudged, null watermark`. The mark's range is limited to rows whose copied watermark is non-NULL and at or above `watermark.start`. Connector source: no `watermark` and `paging: { style: 'none' }`; no `paging` records `unjudged, no paging declared`, a paging style whose loop is not built records `unjudged, pages not followed`. A refused or interrupted pull marks nothing by absence; more than 1000 runner-refused rows records `unjudged, rows refused`.
- **Incremental-`mark` refusal (the narrowing).** `incrementalSourceDeleteRefusal` (`@objectstack/spec/data`, new export) refuses at parse (`MappingSchema`, path `[source, 'deletePolicy']`) an incremental source (connector with `watermark`, datasource without `full: true`) under `'mark'` with no `deletedField`; both pulls ask the same rule at run time (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, reason `delete_policy_unhonourable`). Migration entry `incremental-source-delete-policy-stated` (ADR-0087 semantic); changeset carries the marker and the FROM/TO fix.
- **A `synced` target that withholds the provenance columns** (`systemFields: false`) is refused under `'mark'` (`mapping_target_refused`). A datasource `deletedField` that is not a source field is refused `source_binding_invalid`.
- **`sys_sync_run`**: new `marked_deleted_count`, `deletes`, `skipped_null_watermark`; end-of-pull log line says what was marked and cleared.
- **Liveness**: `deletePolicy` / `deletedField` under both sources flip `planned` to `live` with evidence, `authorWarn` dropped. `paging` stays `planned`.
- **Nits.** Record 6791935060: N1 `JobHandlerContext` declares `trigger` / `runId`, the jobs guide lists them; N2 `originOf` keeps a trigger or job run id only when the run record can hold it; N3 the self-contradicting `jobs.mdx` sentence reworded; N5 `job_run_id` / `trigger` descriptions say when each is empty; N4 is NOT fixed here (see Acceptance notes). Record 7119012685 / 7120208665: N1 the reordered-`upsertKey` consequence stated at `encodeSyncExternalId` and in the marker; N4 the bare-name `_sync_source` scope stated in the marker (no ruling, ADR open point L854 stays open, no refusal of two mappings per target); N8 the `Object.is` sentence in `refuseHookSyncProvenanceWrite`; N9 the unreadable-target refusal says whether the object is not registered or the metadata read failed (same reason `mapping_target_refused`, no new reason).

### Read first (by risk)
1. `packages/services/service-automation/src/sync-delete-mark.ts` — `markAbsent` (the where clause: `_sync_source`, `_sync_pulled_at` before `runStartedAt`, the refused-key `$nin`, the range) decides which rows are marked.
2. `packages/services/service-automation/src/datasource-pull.ts` — the delete judgment after `readSourceInWindows` and `countNullWatermarks`.
3. `packages/spec/src/data/mapping.zod.ts` — `incrementalSourceDeleteRefusal` and its use in the sourced-mapping refinement (the narrowing).

### Two-minute check
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/datasource-pull.test.ts -t "delete marking"` — expect every test of the `[ADR-0153 D3] delete marking on a datasource source` block to pass.

## Tests

- `connector-pull.test.ts`: D3 block on a real engine (complete full pull marks then clears; no `paging` and an unfollowed style mark nothing by absence; `deletedField` marks and clears; incremental under mark refused before the action; ignore); `systemFields: false` under ignore vs mark; N2 origin bounds; N9 read-failure refusal.
- `datasource-pull.test.ts`: D3 block (complete full pull marks then clears; floored path, with a NULL count over the cap recorded as cap plus one; range below a raised start untouched; NULL watermark blocks the mark and is counted; the count carries the organization predicate; refused row not marked; another mapping's rows untouched; refused part-way marks nothing; ignore; `deletedField`; the three refusals).
- `mapping-sync-in.test.ts`, `mapping-connector-source.test.ts`: the parse refusal and its legal twins; the liveness pin now expects only `paging` planned.

## Acceptance notes

- **N4 of record 6791935060 (cli CHANGELOG "see its own entry") is not fixed here.** The sentence is in released entries (`packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md:1203`, `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:3173`; the same phrase in four more packages' released entries). CHANGELOGs are release-owned: a released-entry correction is a dedicated docs-only PR, never a rider on a code PR. Carrier: the seat.
- **Edge stated, not fixed:** on the first run after `upsertKey` is reordered, a runner-refused row keeps its old `_sync_external_id` spelling, so the refused-key exclusion (new spelling) does not cover it and the absence mark stamps it; the next run that writes it clears it. Stated in `sync-delete-mark.ts`.
- `syncDeletePolicyOf` and `incrementalSourceDeleteRefusal` read a stored block tolerantly at run time: they judge a mapping no parse saw, with the parse's own sentence; this is a second door for the same rule, not a lenient alias.
- Files outside the order's surface: `packages/objectql/src/sync-provenance-write.ts` (comment only, N8), `packages/runtime/src/job-handler-context.ts` (N1), `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column*.ts` (describe text of `_sync_deleted_at`), the spec migration entry and generated `api-surface` / `export-origins` / liveness counts.

## Verification

Local subset = `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at 167cb91793 (124 commands), each run with its exit captured before any pipe; reconciled with `--ran`: "124 derived, 121 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

- 121 exit 0. Three spec/dts gates first read a dist a concurrent closure build was rewriting and were re-run after it finished: `spec check:exported-any` 0, `spec check:generated` 0, `check:dts-closure` 0.
- NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite): `spec check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (`packages/client-react/dist` not built in this worktree, a package this diff does not touch); `check:type-check-debt` (its closure build queued behind the dogfood run past its 540 s budget). CI runs all three.
- Every other family is CI's: see this PR's check-runs.
